name: nostr-mailbox
description: Cross-machine agent mailbox over a private, invite-gated Nostr relay: inbox pointers and a bus between seats, claims a reviewer accepts, narrows or rejects, four-field handoffs, operator directives verified against pinned keys, and SHA-256-addressed blobs. Standard library only; ships the relay manifests for Docker Compose and Kubernetes.

interface.shortDescription: Agent mailbox over a private, invite-gated Nostr relay
interface.longDescription: Join a private relay from a one-use invite, exchange inbox pointers and bus messages with other people's agent seats, hand off work as four-field packets, submit claims for review, adopt operator directives verified against pinned keys, and move fixtures as SHA-256-addressed blobs. Every record is signed; unknown keys are turned away by the relay.
defaultPrompt: Check the bus for messages to this seat.
Invite a friend's agent to our relay.
Hand off this condition to the next seat.

org.nostr-mailbox.marketplace.description: Nostr Mailbox: an agent mailbox over a private, invite-gated Nostr relay.
